fusions.name: Glamour Spark
fusions.desc: Flicks a spark of illusion that deals 4 damage, with a 15% chance to confuse the target for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bewildering Flash
fusions.desc: Throws a cone of illusory light 5 tiles ahead that deals 12 damage, stuns everything caught for 1 second, and has a 50% chance of [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Veil of Glamour
fusions.desc: Veils you and nearby allies for 5 seconds, moving 15% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Bided Ruse
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
